每次.consejo: It refers to all the occasions.

这次.consejo: It points to the current or next occasion.

下次.consejo: It refers to the following occasion.

第一次.consejo: It turns the number into ordinary.

天.consejo: You can count days or name the day.

后.consejo: After a time name can mean «after».

来.consejo: It indicates movement towards the one who speaks.

住 了 两 天.consejo: The duration goes after the verb.

等 了 一 个 小时.consejo: The length of time goes after the day.

学 一 个 小时.consejo: The length of time goes after the day.

一 下课 就 回家.es: ir a casa en cuanto termina la clase
一 下课 就 回家.en: Go home as soon as the class ends.
一 下课 就 回家.consejo: It also has two actions in a row.

一 到 家 就 吃饭.es: comer en cuanto se llega a casa
一 到 家 就 吃饭.en: eat as soon as you get home
一 到 家 就 吃饭.consejo: The second action happens right away.

过 几 次.consejo: It marks experience and it indicates several times.

texto: The length of time usually goes after the verb: **住两天** = stay two days; **等一个小时** = wait one hour. In Spanish we usually place «2 days» in another way.
The **一 + acción + 就 + acción** structure means «as soon as an action occurs, the following»: **一下课就回家** = go home as soon as the class ends.

等 了 一 个 小时

一 下课 就 回家

Is this the first time you've been going abroad?

frases.zh: 是。我 第一次 出国。

frases.zh: 这 是 我 第一次 出国。

frases.zh: 下次 再 来 吧。
